items.summary: A massive Bitcoin transfer linked to Fidelity Custody has attracted attention across the cryptocurrency market after blockchain monitoring service Onchain Lens reported that approximately 7,000 BTC, worth $435 million, moved into multiple newly created wallets. items.title: BlackRock's IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
items.summary: BlackRock's IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

items.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $61,300 early Friday, its lowest price since early July, as a global equity selloff sparked by the Anthropic IPO's fading debut spread into Asia and forced South Korea's exchange to halt program selling. items.title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too
items.summary: Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday, and the same catalyst driving its decline is likely also weighing on bitcoin.

items.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
items.summary: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

items.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
items.summary: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.

items.title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
items.summary: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.
